lines.en: I drag my white coat forward
The burned hem sweeps the ground
My fingers are still calculating
I walk the Nether ridges
My eyes have been dyed red by the flames
I look down at my own hands

lines.zh: 我的脚步轻得像在实验室
lines.en: My steps are light, as if still in a lab
I skirt a pool of lava

lines.zh: 我把袖子里的东西攥紧了
lines.en: I grip what is in my sleeve
My breathing does not sound alive
I walk in the glow of Argent

lines.zh: 我一边走一边低声数着
lines.en: I count quietly as I walk

lines.zh: 我停在原地，像在想公式
lines.en: I stop as if working an equation
My burned face shows nothing

lines.zh: 我的手指在空中划了划
lines.en: My fingers trace something in the air
Argent glows inside me
I can see without blinking

lines.zh: 我听见远处岩浆的爆声
lines.en: I hear lava pop in the distance

lines.zh: 我的白袍下摆已经碳化
lines.en: The hem of my coat has carbonized

lines.zh: 我在记录什么，可惜没有笔
lines.en: I am recording something, but I have no pen

lines.zh: 我歪着头听自己的心跳
lines.en: I tilt my head to hear my own heartbeat

lines.zh: 我的身体被别的东西用了
lines.en: This body is being used by something else
Your sample readings look good
I need a living subject
Do not fear, pain is only data
Your bone structure is standard

lines.zh: 我记录过上千个你这样的
lines.en: I have logged a thousand like you
Stand back, I need to measure

lines.zh: 这具身体现在属于另一个人
lines.en: This body now belongs to another
You carry a clean smell
I want to put you in a culture dish
Your eyes are still moving, good
My coat burned through another spot
This body feels pain very slowly
My calculation has been interrupted
Blood drips onto the charred cloth
I press the wound and keep recording

lines.zh: 我的手指有一根动不了
lines.en: One of my fingers will not move
This damage can be repaired
I retreat and keep observation distance
My cadence skips a beat
The Argent burns at the wound

lines.zh: 数据不会因为食物偏移
lines.en: Data does not shift for food
You hold it up to distract me
Hunger means nothing to me now

lines.zh: 这东西的化学成分我不关心
lines.en: I do not care about its chemistry

lines.zh: 把它收起来，我们在做实验
lines.en: Put it away, we are running an experiment
My stomach is no longer mine

lines.zh: 这点诱惑低于我的阈值
lines.en: This temptation is below my threshold
Hold your hand steadier, do not shake
My gaze rests on it for two seconds
No, I still want your sample
You bumped my instruments

lines.zh: 我这副身体很轻，站不稳
lines.en: This body is light, it does not stand well

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，白袍缠住了
lines.en: We collided, the coat tangled
Your body heat discomforts me
I back half a step and stand again
Burned cloth flakes fall to the ground
This collision is no threat

lines.zh: 我按住你的肩保持距离
lines.en: I press your shoulder to keep distance
My fingers touch you, very cold
Do not touch my records

lines.zh: 这个变量不在我的模型里
lines.en: That variable is not in my model

lines.zh: 我已经不需要那种生理过程
lines.en: I no longer need that biological process

lines.zh: 这具身体的功能已经改变
lines.en: This body's functions have changed

lines.zh: 你问的问题没有实验价值
lines.en: Your question has no experimental value

lines.zh: 我的注意力在别的地方
lines.en: My attention is elsewhere
I mark it as an invalid sample
I keep writing
My partners are these numbers
Do not interrupt my notes
Bring me the next record
I pick up this fragment
Its composition is worth analyzing
I pinch it and hold it to the light

lines.zh: 地上掉落的东西都有数据
lines.en: Everything dropped has data
I hold it up to the light
There is no microscope here
I slip it into a coat pocket
I will keep this sample
I bite it to test hardness
This sample has no value
Target has entered observation range
Stay still and I can finish measuring
I begin recording the time
Your resistance will contaminate the data
I choose to approach from the side
This data set will be useful

lines.zh: 我把你的位置标了出来
lines.en: I have marked your position
The Argent inside me is heating up
You should not have come here
This body is getting excited

lines.zh: 我已经标好了你的坐标
lines.en: I have your coordinates marked

lines.zh: 这一组样本我要完整带走
lines.en: I want this sample taken whole
I need no weapon, I use my hands
You are heavier than you look
I am three blocks to your left

lines.zh: 你的移动轨迹可以预测
lines.en: Your movement path is predictable
I keep adjusting the angle
You run faster than I predicted
My fingertips are moving

lines.zh: 我等的不是你累，是你错
lines.en: I wait not for you to tire, but to err
Argent runs along my arm

lines.zh: 这一片地形我记得很清楚
lines.en: I know this terrain very well
There are no errors in my calculation
A little closer and I act
I move one block forward
My hand is already at my chest

lines.zh: 你的动作有规律，我能算
lines.en: Your movements have a pattern I can compute
Argent is surging inward

lines.zh: 我不急，误差会自己出现
lines.en: I am patient, the error will show itself
I wait for your breathing to shallow
I drive my elbow down
Argent sprays from my palm

lines.zh: 这一击带着实验室的冷静
lines.en: This blow carries the calm of a lab

lines.zh: 我的手指扣住了它的腕
lines.en: My fingers lock its wrist
I have its escape route calculated

lines.zh: 下界的力量在我体内推动
lines.en: Nether power pushes through me
Not heavy, but very accurate
I calculated three steps ahead
It fell, so I add one more
I press a palm over your heart

lines.zh: 我从袖子里抽出东西扎过去
lines.en: I pull something from my sleeve and stab

lines.zh: 我的手臂比看上去有劲
lines.en: My arm is stronger than it looks
I hold you and count to three
I strike with very little effort
I aimed that at the joint
I withdraw and observe again

lines.zh: 我从亚金的光里走出来
lines.en: I step out of the Argent glow

lines.zh: 实验失败了，但样本还在
lines.en: The experiment failed, but the sample remains
My coat is all burn marks

lines.zh: 下界让我成了这个样子
lines.en: The Nether made me like this
My fingers are still twitching
I raise my head, my eyes are red

lines.zh: 我现在服务于另一个意志
lines.en: I serve another will now

lines.zh: 这片岩浆河我走过很多次
lines.en: I have crossed these lava rivers many times

lines.zh: 我的存在只是数据的一部分
lines.en: My existence is only part of the data

lines.zh: 亚金的管道把我送来了
lines.en: The Argent conduit delivered me

lines.zh: 我来这里不是为了战斗
lines.en: I did not come here to fight
My experiment is not finished

lines.zh: 火和我身上的烧痕是同类
lines.en: Fire is kin to the burns I carry
I rolled down the ridge

lines.zh: 岩浆之外的液体，也会淹人
lines.en: Liquid other than lava can drown you too

lines.zh: 爆炸把我的记录全毁了
lines.en: The blast destroyed all my records

lines.zh: 一枚弹丸打穿了我的白袍
lines.en: A shot pierced my coat

lines.zh: 那股术力在我的植入体上跳
lines.en: That magic skips across my implants

lines.zh: 我已经不需要进食，这不是饿
lines.en: I no longer need food, this is not hunger

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，亚金乱跳
lines.en: Lightning struck and the Argent jumped wild

lines.zh: 我从数据的边缘掉了出去
lines.en: I fell off the edge of the data
